run_summary: The JMA has issued heavy rain and landslide warnings for the Hamadori region of Fukushima Prefecture. Several volcanic ash forecasts remain in effect for Sakurajima, Satsuma-Iwojima, Kuchinoerabu-jima, Suwanosejima, Kirishima (Shinmon-dake), and Me-Akan-dake, though these are routine status updates for ongoing volcanic activity.

candidates.title: Heavy Rain and Landslide Warning: Fukushima Prefecture (Hamadori)
candidates.formal_status_basis: The Japan Meteorological Agency issued a formal 'Danger Warning' (Kiken Keihou) for heavy rain and landslides in the Hamadori region.
candidates.what_changed: The JMA has issued a formal warning for heavy rain and landslides in the Hamadori region of Fukushima.
candidates.why_it_matters: Travelers in the area face risks of flooding, landslides, and potential transport disruptions due to severe weather conditions.
candidates.traveler_action: Monitor local weather reports, follow instructions from local authorities, and check transport operator websites for potential delays or cancellations.

candidates.reason: High-impact safety information for travelers currently in or planning to visit the affected region.
